text: Fallen shingles plainly visible ~40px above the crosshair at 1.6m (inside reach 2.2m, horizontal bearing +4deg), pitch -57: E says 'Nothing to pick up there.' The 12-degree pick-up cone is tight vertically when debris sits a step away.

Pressing E twice on the fallen rafter stacks the identical status line twice ('The rafter is too long to carry...' x2) under the aim hint, which already says the same thing: three copies of one message.

Sweeping: one 6s broom hold cleans a small spot (floor 9%->11%), then 'Clean here. Move on.' Dirty vs swept floor is hard to tell apart on screen in this light, so it is unclear where to sweep next; clearing the whole floor this way looks like a long grind.
